name: Creamy Bell Pepper, Jalapeño, Onion & Corn Sauté with Warm Tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers. Cut into ½-inch thick strips and transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Wash, dry, and halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice into thin strips and add to the baking sheet with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Drizzle the mixed peppers with oil and season with spices; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast, tossing halfway, until peppers are soft and begin to brown, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; set aside to drain.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add cream cheese, yogurt, cream, and broth to the skillet with the onion; cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is smooth, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
118 ml heavy whipping cream
118 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: When the peppers are done, add them to the skillet along with the corn; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide creamy veggie sauté between bowls; serve with warm tortillas on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
